biography:
DOMi & JD BECK are a jazz fusion duo made up of French keyboardist Domi Louna and American drummer JD Beck, who first connected in 2018 and quickly became known for their virtuosic interplay and playful, internet-savvy presentation. Domi studied at conservatories in France before attending Berklee College of Music, while Beck began playing drums at a young age in Dallas and developed his style through years of live performance and session work.

Their music blends jazz fusion with instrumental hip hop, funk, drum and bass, and rapid-fire improvisation, marked by intricate harmonies, unusual time signatures, and tightly synchronized keyboard-and-drum संवाद. Their breakout came through viral performances and collaborations with artists such as Thundercat, Anderson .Paak, Herbie Hancock, and Ariana Grande, which helped establish them as one of the most talked-about young acts in contemporary jazz.

In 2022, the duo released their debut single “Smile” and their first album, Not Tight, on Blue Note/Apeshit, earning Grammy nominations for Best New Artist and Best Contemporary Instrumental Album. Since then, DOMi & JD BECK have been widely recognized for bringing a modern, genre-blurring energy to jazz fusion while keeping the duo format central to their sound and identity.
